hypothesis: Addition of independently sourced healthy, brown-spot and sheath-blight field images improves source-separated performance beyond equal repeated exposure to these labels.
intervention: 375 Munna unmarked exact-label images versus 375 seeded draws from the same 3 original training classes. Label sequence, training steps, size, random initialization and color statistics match between arms.
selection: Master validation macro-F1 across all 177 classes, loss tie-break within 1e-6, earlier epoch. Compare the best checkpoint of each arm using eight-view probability averaging.
field_measure: Hasan and BanglaRiceLeaf whole-source development cohorts, all 177 predictions eligible. Score exact labels and average F1 across represented classes. Weight the two sources equally to measure transfer. Capture-day and ordinal-bin group summaries are descriptive.
decision: A candidate that passes every guard merits a matched second seed at the same budget. Both pilots are ineligible for deployment, and this development set cannot provide final confirmation. Leave course test and earlier reserved confirmations sealed.
